verdict.rationale: Dispute handling is a fair question for a payments platform like Kushki, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a disputes or chargeback API for retrieving disputes, assembling evidence, or submitting responses. Refunds/voids (kushki-docs-8) and the llms.txt docs index are adjacent features, not dispute handling, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent handle a dispute end-to-end, retrieving it, assembling evidence, and submitting the response via the API
